# Convert Data types
```{r}
convert_to_factors <- function(df, col_indexes) {
  # Check if indexes are within bounds
  if (any(col_indexes > ncol(df))) {
    stop("One or more indexes exceed the number of columns in the data frame.")
  }
  
  # Convert selected columns to factor
  df[col_indexes] <- lapply(df[col_indexes], as.factor)
  
  return(df)
}
gym <- convert_to_factors(gym, c(1:6,9,11,13))
```

# Tests of independence
```{r}
gtests <- function(df, target_col_index_range, reference_col) {
  # If reference_col is a name, get its index
  if (is.character(reference_col)) {
    reference_col_index <- which(names(df) == reference_col)
  } else {
    reference_col_index <- reference_col
  }

  # Initialize result container
  results <- data.frame(Column = character(), P_Value = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Loop over each target column index
  for (i in target_col_index_range) {
    target_col_name <- names(df)[i]
    reference_col_name <- names(df)[reference_col_index]
    
    target_col <- df[[i]]
    ref_col <- df[[reference_col_index]]
    
    # Construct contingency table
    tbl <- table(target_col, ref_col)
    
    # Print the table
    cat("\nContingency Table for:", target_col_name, "vs", reference_col_name, "\n")
    print(tbl)
    
    # Only run G-test if table is valid
    if (nrow(tbl) > 1 && ncol(tbl) > 1) {
      g_result <- GTest(tbl)
      p_val <- g_result$p.value
    } else {
      p_val <- NA  # Not enough variability to run test
    }
    
    # Append result
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(Column = target_col_name, P_Value = p_val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}


test_independence <- gtests(gym, c(1:6,9,11), "Churn")

print(test_independence)

```

 # Tests comparing Sample Means
```{r}
anova_tests <- function(df, col_indexes, group_var_name) {
  # Check if group_var_name exists
  if (!(group_var_name %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Grouping variable not found in data frame.")
  }
  
  # Ensure group variable is a factor
  df[[group_var_name]] <- as.factor(df[[group_var_name]])
  
  # Initialize results container
  results <- data.frame(Variable = character(), P_Value = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Loop over selected column indexes
  for (i in col_indexes) {
    var_name <- names(df)[i]
    
    # Build formula: variable ~ group
    formula <- as.formula(paste(var_name, "~", group_var_name))
    
    # Run ANOVA using aov()
    aov_result <- aov(formula, data = df)
    
    # Extract p-value from ANOVA summary
    p_val <- summary(aov_result)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
    
    # Append result
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(Variable = var_name, P_Value = p_val, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}

anova_table <- anova_tests(gym, c(7,8,10,12), "Churn")
print(anova_table)
```

# Numeric Plots facet wrap by "Churn"
```{r}
box_plots <- function(df_box, cluster) {
  # Prepare the data for boxplots
  numeric_data_box <- df_box %>%
    dplyr::select_if(is.numeric) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster_col = df_box[[cluster]]) %>%  # Dynamically add the cluster column
    tidyr::gather(var, value, -cluster_col)  # Gather the data into long format
  
  # Create the boxplot
  ggplot(numeric_data_box, aes(x = factor(cluster_col), y = value, fill = factor(cluster_col))) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", name = "Churn Group") +
    labs(
      title = "Boxplots by Churn Group",
      x = "Churn",
      y = "Values"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~var, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

box_plots(df_box = gym, cluster = "Churn")

```
# Residual Analysis
```{r}
chisq_stdres <- function(df, col_indexes, group_var) {
  # Check if group_var exists
  if (!(group_var %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Grouping variable not found in the data frame.")
  }

  for (i in col_indexes) {
    var_name <- names(df)[i]
    
    # Create contingency table
    contingency_tbl <- table(df[[group_var]], df[[var_name]])
    
    # Perform Chi-squared test without Yates' correction
    test_result <- chisq.test(contingency_tbl, correct = FALSE)
    
    # Print variable name and p-value
    cat("\nVariable:", var_name, "\n")
    print(test_result)
    
    # Print standardized residuals
    cat("Standardized residuals:\n")
    print(test_result$stdres)
  }
}

chisq_stdres(gym, c(1:6,9,11), "Churn")

```
# Building Logistic Regression Model
```{r}
# creating a validation group
set.seed(3839)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(gym$Churn,
                                  p = 0.7,
                                  list = F,
                                  times = 1)
gym_train <- gym[trainIndex,]  # training set
gym_test <- gym[-trainIndex,]  # hold out test set

K <- 5 # cross validation
set.seed(3839)
control_5kf <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = K)
lambda_grid <- 10^seq(-10,10, length=101)  
lasso_lambda <- -1.85 # optimized parameter for lasso
ridge_lambda <- -1.55 # optimized parameter for ridge
set.seed(3839)
fit_lasso <- train(Churn ~ .,
                   data = gym_train,
                   method = "glmnet",
                   metric = "Accuracy",
                   tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 1, lambda = lambda_grid),
                   trControl = control_5kf
                   )
set.seed(3839)
fit_ridge <- train(Churn ~ .,
                   data = gym_train,
                   method = "glmnet",
                   metric = "Accuracy",
                   tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0, lambda = lambda_grid),
                   trControl = control_5kf
                   )

plot(fit_lasso, xTrans = log10)
plot(fit_ridge, xTrans = log10)
```

# Model Performance based on Specificity, Sensitivity, AUC, and Accuracy
```{r}
predictions_lasso <- data.frame(
  y_lasso = gym_test$Churn,
  phat_lasso = predict(fit_lasso, type = "prob", newdata =
                         gym_test)$'1',
  yhat_lasso = predict(fit_lasso, type = "raw", newdata = gym_test)
)

predictions_ridge <- data.frame(
  y_ridge = gym_test$Churn,
  phat_ridge = predict(fit_ridge, type = "prob", newdata =
                         gym_test)$'1',
  yhat_ridge = predict(fit_ridge, type = "raw", newdata = gym_test)
)

predictions_ridge_no_gender <- data.frame(
  y_ridge = gym_test$Churn,
  phat_ridge_no_gender = predict(ridge_no_gender, type = "prob", newdata =
                         gym_test)$'1',
  yhat_ridge_no_gender = predict(ridge_no_gender, type = "raw", newdata = 
                                   gym_test)
)

roc_lasso <- roc(predictions_lasso, y_lasso, phat_lasso)

roc_ridge <- roc(predictions_ridge, y_ridge, phat_ridge)

roc_ridge_2 <- roc(predictions_ridge_no_gender, y_ridge, phat_ridge_no_gender)

roc_list = list(Lasso = roc_lasso, Ridge = roc_ridge, Ridge_No_Gender = roc_ridge_2)
ggroc(roc_list) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=1, xend=0, y=0, yend=1), color = "grey",
               linetype = "dashed") +
  ggtitle("ROC Curves for Test Set")

acc_lasso <- accuracy(predictions_lasso, y_lasso, yhat_lasso)
acc_ridge <- accuracy(predictions_ridge, y_ridge, yhat_ridge)
acc_ridge_2 <- accuracy(predictions_ridge_no_gender, y_ridge, 
                        yhat_ridge_no_gender)

# Lasso confusion matrix
cm_lasso <- confusionMatrix(predictions_lasso$yhat_lasso,
                            predictions_lasso$y_lasso, positive = "0")

# Ridge confusion matrix
cm_ridge <- confusionMatrix(predictions_ridge$yhat_ridge,
                            predictions_ridge$y_ridge, positive = "0")

# Ridge (no gender) confusion matrix
cm_ridge_2 <- confusionMatrix(predictions_ridge_no_gender$yhat_ridge_no_gender,
                              predictions_ridge_no_gender$y_ridge, positive = "0")
# Extract Sensitivity and Specificity
sensitivity <- c(cm_lasso$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                     cm_ridge$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                     cm_ridge_2$byClass["Sensitivity"])

specificity <- c(cm_lasso$byClass["Specificity"],
                     cm_ridge$byClass["Specificity"],
                     cm_ridge_2$byClass["Specificity"])


# Create a data frame summarizing the model and performance
Model_perf <- data.frame(
  Name_of_Model = c("Lasso", "Ridge", "Ridge No Gender"),
  Accuracy = c(round(acc_lasso$.estimate,4), round(acc_ridge$.estimate,4), 
               round(acc_ridge_2$.estimate,4)),
  AUC = c(round(auc(roc_lasso),4), round(auc(roc_ridge),4), 
          round(auc(roc_ridge_2),4)),
  Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 4),
  Specificity = round(specificity, 4)
)

Model_perf
```

```{r}
stacked_proportion_tables <- function(df, cols, compare_col) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store each proportion table
  prop_list <- list()
  
  for (col_index in cols) {
    col_name <- names(df)[col_index]
    
    # Create a contingency table between selected column and compare_col
    tab <- table(df[[col_name]], df[[compare_col]])
    
    # Convert to proportion table by column
    prop_tab <- round(prop.table(tab, margin = 2), 2)
    
    # Convert to data frame for merging
    prop_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(prop_tab)
    
    # Recode column names from "0"/"1" to "Stay"/"Churn"
    colnames(prop_df) <- gsub("^0$", "Stay", colnames(prop_df))
    colnames(prop_df) <- gsub("^1$", "Churn", colnames(prop_df))
    
    # Add identifier columns
    prop_df$Variable <- col_name
    prop_df$Level <- rownames(prop_df)
    
    # Reorder columns
    prop_df <- prop_df[, c("Variable", "Level", setdiff(names(prop_df), c("Variable", "Level")))]
    
    # Reset row names
    rownames(prop_df) <- NULL
    
    # Store
    prop_list[[col_name]] <- prop_df
  }
  
  # Combine all into one data frame
  result <- do.call(rbind, prop_list)
  return(result)
}

churn_prop <- stacked_proportion_tables(gym, c(11,9), "Churn")
```
